title: Roast Chicken with Potatoes and Carrots
text: Heat the oven to 425F. Rub the chicken with oil, thyme, salt and pepper. Scatter potatoes, carrots and onion in a roasting pan, set the chicken on top and roast for 1 hour 15 minutes until the juices run clear. Rest 10 minutes before carving.

title: Chicken and Vegetable Stew
text: Brown the chicken in a heavy pot, remove, and soften the onion and garlic. Return the chicken, add water, bay leaf, potatoes and carrots. Simmer gently for 45 minutes until the chicken is tender.

title: Potato and Carrot Soup
text: Melt the butter and soften the chopped onion. Add potatoes, carrots and water, then simmer 25 minutes. Blend until smooth and season to taste.

title: Garlic Roasted Potatoes
text: Toss cut potatoes with oil, garlic, rosemary and salt. Roast at 425F for 40 minutes, turning once, until golden and crisp.

title: Glazed Carrots
text: Simmer sliced carrots in a little water until nearly tender. Drain, add butter and honey, and cook until glossy. Finish with lemon juice.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
text: Cook onion, potatoes and carrots in stock until tender. Thicken with flour, stir in chicken and peas, pour into a crust, cover and bake at 400F for 35 minutes.

title: Lemon Garlic Chicken
text: Marinate chicken in lemon juice, garlic, oil and oregano for 30 minutes. Roast at 400F for 35 minutes until browned.

title: Chicken Fried Rice
text: Scramble the eggs and set aside. Stir-fry chicken, carrot and peas in hot oil. Add rice and soy sauce, fold in eggs and scallions and serve hot.

title: Beef and Potato Hash
text: Fry the potatoes in oil until browning. Add onion, carrot and beef and cook until the beef is done. Season well.

title: Classic Beef Stew
text: Dredge beef in flour and brown. Add onion, tomato paste, stock and bay leaf, then simmer for 1.5 hours. Add potatoes and carrots for the last 30 minutes.

title: Tomato Basil Pasta
text: Cook pasta. Warm garlic in oil, add tomatoes and cook 10 minutes, then toss with pasta and torn basil.

title: Spaghetti Carbonara
text: Cook pasta. Crisp the bacon. Beat eggs with parmesan and pepper, toss with hot pasta and bacon off the heat until creamy.

title: Mushroom Risotto
text: Soften onion and mushrooms in butter. Add rice, then stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for 20 minutes. Finish with parmesan.

title: Vegetable Frittata
text: Fry potato and onion in an oven-safe pan until soft. Pour over beaten eggs and cheese and bake at 375F for 15 minutes.

title: Pancakes
text: Whisk dry ingredients, add milk, egg and butter, and cook spoonfuls on a hot griddle until bubbles form, then flip.

title: Chickpea and Spinach Curry
text: Soften onion and garlic in oil, add curry powder, tomatoes and chickpeas, simmer 15 minutes, and wilt in the spinach.

title: Lentil Soup
text: Soften the vegetables, add lentils, tomatoes, cumin and water, and simmer 30 minutes until the lentils are tender.

title: Baked Salmon with Lemon
text: Place salmon on a tray, drizzle with oil and lemon, sprinkle with dill, and bake at 400F for 12 minutes.

title: Shepherd's Pie
text: Boil and mash potatoes with butter and milk. Brown lamb with onion and carrots, stir in flour and peas, top with the mash, and bake at 400F for 25 minutes.

title: Beef Tacos
text: Brown the beef with seasoning. Fill shells with beef, tomato, lettuce and cheese.

title: Egg Salad Sandwich
text: Chop the eggs, mix with mayonnaise and mustard, season, and spread on bread.

title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
text: Hollow the peppers. Mix browned beef, rice, onion and tomatoes, fill the peppers, top with cheese, and bake at 375F for 35 minutes.

title: Banana Bread
text: Mash bananas, mix in butter, sugar and egg, fold in flour and soda, and bake in a loaf pan at 350F for 60 minutes.

title: Chicken Noodle Soup
text: Simmer chicken with vegetables in stock for 20 minutes, shred the chicken, add noodles, and cook 8 minutes.

title: Honey Mustard Chicken and Carrots
text: Whisk honey and mustard, coat chicken and carrots on a sheet pan, and roast at 425F for 35 minutes.

title: Weeknight Paprika Chicken Skillet
text: Season the chicken with salt, pepper, paprika, and oregano. Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat, brown the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes per side, then transfer to a plate. Add the onion and bell pepper to the pan and cook for 4 minutes, stir in the garlic for 30 seconds, return the chicken, add the broth, cover, and simmer on low for 10 to 12 minutes until the chicken reaches 165°F.

title: Miso-Glazed Chicken Thighs
text: Whisk the miso, soy sauce, honey, vinegar, sesame oil, garlic, and ginger into a smooth glaze. Brush it over the chicken thighs and place them on a foil-lined sheet pan. Bake at 425°F for 22 to 28 minutes, basting once halfway through, until the chicken is cooked through and nicely caramelized; finish with scallions and sesame seeds.

title: Creamy Spinach Chicken Orzo
ingredient_lines: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, cut into bite-size pieces
text: Warm the oil in a deep skillet over medium heat and cook the chicken with salt and pepper for 4 to 5 minutes, until lightly browned. Stir in the garlic and orzo for 1 minute, then add the broth and simmer uncovered for about 10 minutes, stirring often, until the orzo is tender. Lower the heat, stir in the cream, spinach, and parmesan, and cook for 2 minutes until glossy and combined.

title: Orange Ginger Chicken Stir-Fry
text: Mix the orange juice, soy sauce, honey, ginger, and cornstarch in a small bowl. Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a wok or skillet over medium-high heat and stir-fry the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes; remove it, then cook the vegetables in the remaining oil for 3 to 4 minutes. Return the chicken, pour in the sauce, and cook for 1 to 2 minutes until thickened and glossy.

title: Sheet Pan Dijon Chicken with Green Beans
text: Stir together the mustard, olive oil, lemon juice, thyme, salt, and pepper, then coat the drumsticks well. Arrange the chicken on a sheet pan and roast at 425°F for 15 minutes. Add the green beans and shallot around the chicken, roast 20 to 25 minutes more until the chicken reaches 165°F, and scatter parsley over the top before serving.

title: Turkey Taco Lettuce Skillet
text: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat and cook the onion and turkey for 5 to 6 minutes, breaking up the meat as it browns. Add the garlic and taco seasoning and cook for 30 seconds, then stir in the tomato sauce, corn, and black beans and simmer for 4 minutes. Spoon the mixture into lettuce leaves and top with avocado.

title: Garlic Herb Turkey Meatballs with Couscous
text: Combine the turkey, egg, breadcrumbs, parmesan, garlic, and Italian seasoning, then roll into meatballs. Brown them in olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes, turning gently until golden on all sides. Add the broth, cover, and simmer for 8 minutes until cooked through, then stir in the couscous, cover off heat for 5 minutes, and fluff with parsley.

title: Coconut Curry Chicken Bites
text: Cook the onion in coconut oil over medium heat for 4 minutes, then add the curry paste and stir for 1 minute. Add the chicken and cook for 5 minutes, pour in the coconut milk, and simmer for 8 to 10 minutes until the chicken is done. Stir in the snap peas and lime juice for the last 2 minutes, then serve over rice with cilantro.

title: Maple Mustard Chicken Tenders
text: Whisk the mustard, maple syrup, oil, vinegar, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper into a quick glaze. Coat the chicken tenders and arrange them in a single layer on a baking sheet. Bake at 400°F for 16 to 18 minutes, flipping once halfway through, until the chicken is cooked through and the glaze is sticky; finish with chives.

title: Greek Chicken Pita Skillet
text: Toss the chicken with olive oil, oregano, garlic powder, salt, and pepper, then cook it in a skillet over medium-high heat for 6 to 7 minutes until browned and cooked through. Mix the tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, yogurt, and lemon juice in a bowl. Warm the pita breads for 1 to 2 minutes, fill them with chicken and vegetables, and spoon the sauce over the top.

title: Balsamic Peach Chicken Cutlets
text: Season the chicken with salt and pepper and sear it in olive oil over medium-high heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side, then set aside. In the same pan, cook the shallot for 1 minute, add the peaches, balsamic vinegar, honey, thyme, and butter, and simmer for 3 to 4 minutes until syrupy. Return the chicken to the pan for 1 minute to glaze and serve warm.

title: One-Pan Turkey and Sweet Potato Skillet
text: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat and cook the sweet potato and onion for 6 to 7 minutes, stirring often. Add the turkey, garlic, chili powder, cumin, and salt, and cook for 5 minutes until the turkey is no longer pink. Pour in the broth, cover, and simmer for 8 minutes, then stir in the kale and cook uncovered for 2 minutes until wilted.

title: Red Wine Braised Beef Short Ribs
text: Preheat the oven to 325°F. Season the ribs with salt and pepper, then sear them in olive oil in a Dutch oven until browned on all sides; remove and cook the onion, carrots, celery, garlic, and tomato paste for 3 minutes. Pour in the wine and broth, add thyme, return the ribs, cover, and braise for 2 1/2 to 3 hours until very tender.

title: Crispy Pork Chops with Apple Onion Pan Sauce
text: Season the pork chops, lightly dust with flour, and sear in butter and oil over medium-high heat for 4 to 5 minutes per side until cooked through. Transfer to a plate, then sauté the apple and onion in the same pan for 5 minutes, stirring in broth, Dijon, and vinegar. Simmer for 2 minutes and spoon the sauce over the chops.

title: Rosemary Garlic Lamb Leg Roast
text: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Rub the lamb with olive oil, lemon juice, salt, pepper, rosemary, and garlic, then place it in a roasting pan with the onion wedges and water. Roast for 20 minutes, reduce the temperature to 350°F, and continue roasting for 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours until the center reaches your preferred doneness.

title: Pork Tenderloin with Mustard Cream Sauce
text: Preheat the oven to 425°F. Sear the pork tenderloin in olive oil for about 2 minutes per side, then transfer to the oven and roast for 18 to 22 minutes until the internal temperature reaches 145°F. Rest the meat for 5 minutes, then simmer the shallot, broth, cream, mustard, and thyme in the pan for 3 to 4 minutes and serve over sliced pork.

title: Braised Lamb Shanks with Tomatoes and Herbs
text: Preheat the oven to 325°F. Brown the lamb shanks in olive oil, then remove them and cook the onion, carrots, and garlic for 5 minutes before adding tomatoes, broth, oregano, and bay leaf. Return the shanks, cover tightly, and braise for 2 1/2 hours until the meat is falling off the bone.

title: Chinese-Style Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry
text: Toss the beef with soy sauce and cornstarch, then sear it in hot oil over high heat for 2 to 3 minutes until browned. Add the garlic and broccoli, stir-fry for 2 minutes, then pour in the broth, oyster sauce, and sugar. Cook for another 2 minutes until the sauce thickens, then finish with green onions.

title: Pork Meatballs in Tomato Basil Sauce
text: Mix the pork, egg, breadcrumbs, Parmesan, garlic, salt, and pepper, then form into 1 1/2-inch meatballs. Brown them in olive oil over medium heat for about 6 minutes, turning to color all sides. Add the marinara, cover, and simmer on low for 15 minutes, then stir in basil before serving.

title: Lamb Kofta with Yogurt Herb Sauce
text: Combine the lamb, onion, garlic, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper, then shape into small logs or patties. Cook in olive oil over medium heat for 8 to 10 minutes, turning occasionally until browned and cooked through. Stir together the yogurt and mint and serve as a cool sauce alongside the kofta.

title: Slow Cooker BBQ Pulled Pork Sandwich Filling
text: Place the onion in the slow cooker, set the pork shoulder on top, and mix the barbecue sauce, cider, vinegar, brown sugar, paprika, and salt; pour it over the meat. Cook on low for 8 to 9 hours or on high for 5 to 6 hours until the pork shreds easily. Pull it apart with forks, toss with the sauce, and pile onto buns.

title: Moroccan Beef Tagine-Style Skillet
ingredient_lines: 1 1/2 lb beef chuck, cut into cubes
text: Brown the beef in olive oil over medium-high heat, then add the onion and garlic and cook for 3 minutes. Stir in cinnamon, cumin, tomatoes, broth, chickpeas, and apricots, cover, and simmer on low for 1 1/2 to 2 hours until the beef is tender. Uncover for the last 10 minutes if you want the sauce a little thicker.

title: Lemon Garlic Lamb Chops with Couscous
text: Season the lamb chops with salt, pepper, garlic, lemon zest, and lemon juice, then sear in olive oil over medium-high heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side. While they rest for 5 minutes, stir couscous, hot water, butter, and parsley together in a bowl, cover, and let stand for 5 minutes. Fluff the couscous and serve with the chops.

title: Smothered Pork Shoulder with Onions and Peppers
ingredient_lines: 2 1/2 lb pork shoulder, cut into chunks
text: Toss the pork with salt, pepper, and flour, then brown it in oil in a deep skillet over medium-high heat. Add the onions, peppers, and garlic and cook for 4 minutes, then pour in the broth, Worcestershire sauce, and thyme. Cover and simmer on low for 1 1/2 hours until the pork is tender and the sauce is rich.

title: Lemon-Dill Cod with Roasted Fennel
text: Heat the oven to 425°F and toss the fennel with 1 tablespoon of the oil, salt, and pepper on a sheet pan; roast for 15 minutes. Nestle the cod on top, drizzle with the remaining oil, lemon juice, garlic, and zest, then roast 10 to 12 minutes more until the fish flakes easily. Finish with dill and serve hot.

title: Garlic Butter Shrimp and Corn Skillet
ingredient_lines: 1 1/2 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined
text: Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat, then cook the corn for 4 to 5 minutes until lightly browned. Add the garlic, shrimp, paprika, and salt, and cook 2 to 3 minutes per side until the shrimp turn pink. Stir in lemon juice and parsley, then serve right away.

title: Crispy Salmon Rice Bowls with Cucumber Slaw
text: Heat the oven to 400°F and roast the salmon on a lined baking sheet for 12 to 15 minutes until just cooked through. Toss the cucumber, carrot, vinegar, sesame oil, and soy sauce, then divide the rice into bowls and top with the slaw and salmon. Sprinkle with sesame seeds before serving.

title: Tomato-Pepper Mussels in White Wine Broth
text: Warm the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and cook the onion for 5 minutes until soft, then add the garlic and red pepper flakes for 30 seconds. Stir in the tomatoes and wine, bring to a simmer, and add the mussels; cover and cook 5 to 7 minutes until they open. Discard any unopened mussels, scatter parsley over the top, and serve with crusty bread.

title: Coconut Lime Tilapia with Mango Salsa
text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Dip the tilapia in egg, then press into the coconut and panko mixture, place on a greased sheet pan, and bake for 12 to 14 minutes until crisp and opaque. Mix the mango, onion, lime juice, and cilantro for a quick salsa and spoon it over the fish.

title: Scallop and Pea Orzo with Parmesan
text: Cook the orzo in broth over medium heat for about 9 minutes, stirring often, until tender and most of the liquid is absorbed. In a skillet, heat the olive oil and butter, sear the scallops for 2 minutes per side, and add the garlic and peas for the last minute. Fold the scallops, Parmesan, and orzo together, then serve immediately.

title: Sheet Pan Haddock with Cherry Tomatoes and Zucchini
text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the zucchini and tomatoes with olive oil, oregano, salt, and pepper on a sheet pan, then roast for 10 minutes. Add the haddock and roast 10 to 12 minutes more until the fish is flaky; serve with lemon wedges.

title: Spicy Tuna Patties with Herb Yogurt
text: Mix the tuna, egg, breadcrumbs, green onions, chili flakes, and lemon juice, then form into 6 small patties. Pan-fry in a lightly oiled skillet over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side until golden and heated through. Stir the yogurt and dill together and serve as a cool topping.

title: Miso-Glazed Trout with Bok Choy
text: Heat the oven to 400°F. Whisk the miso, honey, soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil, and ginger, brush it over the trout, and arrange the bok choy around it on a baking dish. Bake for 14 to 16 minutes until the fish is cooked through and the bok choy is tender.

title: Herbed Clam and Potato Chowder
text: Melt the butter in a pot over medium heat and cook the onion and celery for 5 minutes. Add the potatoes, milk, bay leaf, and clams, then cover and simmer 12 to 15 minutes until the clams open and the potatoes are tender. Remove the bay leaf, discard any unopened clams, and finish with chives.

title: Garlic Herb Swordfish with Green Beans
text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the green beans with 1 tablespoon of the oil, salt, pepper, and half the garlic, then roast on a sheet pan for 8 minutes. Push the beans aside, add the swordfish brushed with the remaining oil, thyme, and garlic, and roast 10 to 12 minutes more; serve with lemon slices.

title: Seafood Tomato Stew with Polenta
ingredient_lines: 1 lb mixed seafood (shrimp, scallops, and fish chunks)
text: Cook the onion in a pot with a little oil over medium heat for 5 minutes, then stir in the garlic, tomatoes, broth, and paprika. Simmer for 15 minutes, add the seafood, and cook 4 to 6 minutes more until everything is just done. Meanwhile, cook the polenta according to package directions, then ladle the stew over it and top with basil.

title: Spinach and Ricotta Stuffed Shells
text: Heat the oven to 375°F and cook the pasta shells until just tender, then drain. Mix the ricotta, spinach, mozzarella, parmesan, egg, garlic, and oil, stuff the shells, and arrange them in a baking dish over the marinara. Cover and bake for 25 minutes, then uncover and bake 10 minutes more until bubbly and lightly browned.

title: Sweet Potato Black Bean Enchilada Skillet
ingredient_lines: 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed
8 small corn tortillas, cut into strips
text: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Sauté the sweet potatoes in oil for 8 minutes, add the onion and garlic for 3 minutes, then stir in the beans, enchilada sauce, corn, and tortilla strips. Top with cheddar and bake for 15-18 minutes until the potatoes are tender and the cheese is melted.

title: Mushroom Barley Stew with Thyme
text: Warm the butter or oil in a pot over medium heat, then cook the onion, carrots, and mushrooms for 8 minutes until the mushrooms release their juices. Add the garlic, barley, broth, thyme, salt, and pepper, then bring to a boil. Reduce to a simmer, cover, and cook for 35-40 minutes until the barley is tender and the stew is thick.

title: Cauliflower Chickpea Coconut Rice Bowl
text: Cook the rice according to the package directions. Toss the cauliflower and chickpeas with oil, curry powder, and salt, then roast at 425°F for 20-25 minutes until browned. Warm the coconut milk with water in a small pan, spoon it over the rice and vegetables, and finish with lime.

title: Broccoli Cheddar Quinoa Bake
text: Heat the oven to 375°F and grease a baking dish. Simmer the quinoa in vegetable broth for about 15 minutes, then stir in the broccoli, cheddar, eggs, milk, paprika, salt, and pepper. Bake for 30-35 minutes until the center is set and the top is golden.

title: Tomato Basil White Bean Gnocchi
ingredient_lines: 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
text: Bring a pot of water to a boil and cook the gnocchi until they float, then drain. In a skillet, heat the oil and cook the garlic and tomatoes for 4-5 minutes, add the beans and broth, and simmer for 3 minutes. Toss in the gnocchi, basil, parmesan, salt, and red pepper flakes, then serve right away.

title: Eggplant Parmesan Casserole
text: Sprinkle the eggplant with salt and let it sit for 15 minutes, then pat dry. Dredge each slice in flour, egg, and breadcrumbs, place on a baking sheet, and bake at 425°F for 20 minutes, flipping once. Layer the baked slices with marinara, mozzarella, and parmesan in a casserole dish, then bake 15 minutes more until melted and bubbling.

title: Zucchini Corn Fritters with Herbed Yogurt
text: Squeeze excess moisture from the zucchini, then mix it with corn, flour, eggs, scallions, baking powder, and a pinch of salt. Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat and cook spoonfuls of batter for 3-4 minutes per side until crisp and browned. Stir the yogurt and dill together and serve alongside the fritters.

title: Peanut Soba Noodles with Crispy Tofu
ingredient_lines: 1 block firm tofu, pressed and cubed
text: Cook the soba noodles according to the package directions, then drain. Toss the tofu with cornstarch and oil, and bake at 425°F for 20-25 minutes or pan-fry until crisp. Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, vinegar, honey, and a splash of water, then toss with the noodles, vegetables, and tofu.

title: Butternut Squash and Sage Lasagna
text: Heat the oven to 375°F and cook the lasagna noodles until flexible. Warm the squash puree with butter, sage, salt, and pepper, then layer noodles, squash, ricotta, spinach, mozzarella, and parmesan in a baking dish. Cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes, then uncover and bake 15 minutes more until browned.

title: Corn and Poblano Polenta Bowls
ingredient_lines: 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed
text: Bring the water and salt to a boil, whisk in the polenta, and cook on low for 20-25 minutes, stirring often until creamy. Meanwhile, sauté the poblanos and corn in olive oil for 6-8 minutes, then warm the beans in the same pan. Spoon the polenta into bowls, top with the vegetables, beans, avocado, and lime.

title: Lemon Herb Risotto with Asparagus and Peas
text: Heat the oil in a wide pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 4 minutes until soft. Stir in the rice, then add the warm broth a ladle at a time, stirring often for about 18-20 minutes until creamy. Add the asparagus and peas during the last 5 minutes, then finish with lemon zest, lemon juice, parmesan, and parsley.

title: Smoky Black Bean Stuffed Peppers
ingredient_lines: 4 large bell peppers, halved and seeded
text: Heat the oven to 400°F and place the pepper halves cut-side up in a baking dish. In a skillet over medium heat, warm the olive oil and cook the onion for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, black beans, rice, corn, paprika, cumin, salsa, salt, and pepper and cook for 3 minutes. Spoon the filling into the peppers, top with vegan cheese, cover with foil, and bake for 25 minutes; uncover and bake 10 minutes more until the peppers are tender.

title: Coconut Chickpea Tomato Stew
text: Melt the coconut oil in a pot over medium heat and cook the onion for 5 minutes until soft. Stir in the garlic, ginger, and curry powder for 1 minute, then add the chickpeas, tomatoes, coconut milk, and salt and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes. Stir in the spinach and lime juice, cook for 2 minutes more, and serve hot over rice.

title: Sheet Pan Harissa Cauliflower and Potatoes
text: Heat the oven to 425°F and line a large baking sheet with parchment. Toss the cauliflower, potatoes, olive oil, harissa, cumin, salt, and pepper, then spread them out on the pan and roast for 20 minutes. Add the chickpeas, stir once, and roast 15 minutes more until everything is browned and crisp at the edges; finish with parsley and lemon juice.

title: Creamy Mushroom Polenta with Herbed Greens
ingredient_lines: 4 cups chopped kale or Swiss chard
text: Bring the vegetable broth to a boil in a saucepan, whisk in the polenta, reduce the heat to low, and cook for 20 minutes, stirring often, until thick and creamy. Meanwhile, heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and sauté the mushrooms for 6 minutes, then add the garlic, thyme, greens, salt, and pepper and cook until wilted. Stir the oat milk and nutritional yeast into the polenta, spoon into bowls, and top with the mushroom mixture.

title: Lemon Tahini Roasted Brussels Sprouts and Farro
text: Heat the oven to 425°F and toss the Brussels sprouts with olive oil, salt, and pepper; roast on a sheet pan for 20 to 25 minutes until deeply browned. While they roast, simmer the farro in water for about 20 minutes until tender, then drain any excess water. Whisk the tahini, lemon juice, maple syrup, garlic, and 2 to 3 tbsp water into a smooth sauce, then toss everything together and sprinkle with pumpkin seeds.

title: Tofu and Broccoli Sesame Noodle Stir-Fry
text: Cook the rice noodles according to package directions, then drain and set aside. Toss the tofu with cornstarch and fry it in neutral oil over medium-high heat for 8 to 10 minutes until crisp; add the broccoli and bell pepper and cook for 4 minutes, then stir in the garlic, soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, maple syrup, and chili flakes. Add the noodles and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glossy and heated through.

title: Roasted Tomato and White Bean Bruschetta Skillet
ingredient_lines: 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
text: Heat the oven to 400°F. In an oven-safe skillet, combine the olive oil, cherry tomatoes, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper, then roast for 20 minutes until the tomatoes burst; stir in the cannellini beans and red pepper flakes and roast 8 minutes more. Finish with basil and balsamic vinegar, then spoon the mixture over toasted baguette slices.

title: Sweet Potato and Kale Breakfast Hash
text: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and cook the sweet potatoes with a splash of water for 10 minutes, stirring often. Add the onion and bell pepper and cook 6 minutes more, then stir in the kale, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper and cook until the kale wilts and the potatoes are tender, about 4 minutes. Top with avocado and hot sauce before serving.

title: Miso Ginger Eggplant Bowls
text: Heat the oven to 425°F and toss the eggplant with sesame oil; roast on a sheet pan for 20 minutes. Whisk the neutral oil, ginger, garlic, miso, soy sauce, and maple syrup together, then toss it with the hot eggplant and snap peas in a skillet over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes until glazed and tender. Serve over rice and top with sesame seeds and scallions.

title: Curried Lentil and Carrot Hand Pies
text: Preheat the oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet with parchment. Cook the onion in olive oil over medium heat for 4 minutes, then add the carrots, garlic, curry powder, lentils, peas, salt, and pepper and cook for 3 minutes before cooling slightly. Cut the puff pastry into squares, fill and seal them, brush with plant milk, and bake for 18 to 22 minutes until golden.

title: Zucchini Pesto Flatbread
text: Heat the oven to 450°F and place the flatbreads on a baking sheet. Spread each with pesto, then top with zucchini, cherry tomatoes, red onion, vegan mozzarella, olive oil, salt, and pepper. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes until the edges are crisp and the cheese is melted, then finish with fresh basil.

title: Apple Walnut Farro Salad with Maple Mustard Dressing
text: Simmer the farro in water for about 20 minutes until tender, then drain and cool slightly. Whisk the olive oil, Dijon mustard, maple syrup, apple cider vinegar, salt, and pepper in a large bowl, then add the farro, apples, celery, walnuts, cranberries, and arugula and toss well. Serve right away or chill for 15 minutes to let the flavors mingle.

title: Smoky Black Bean and Sweet Potato Soup
ingredient_lines: 1 large sweet potato, peeled and cubed
2 cans black beans, drained and rinsed
text: Warm the oil in a large pot over medium heat, then cook the onion for 5 minutes until soft before adding the garlic for 30 seconds. Stir in the sweet potato, beans, tomatoes, broth, and seasonings, bring to a boil, then lower the heat and simmer uncovered for 20-25 minutes until the sweet potato is tender. Mash a few beans against the side of the pot for a thicker texture and serve hot.

title: Turkey, Kale, and White Bean Stew
ingredient_lines: 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
text: Heat the oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat and brown the turkey for 5-6 minutes, breaking it up as it cooks. Add the onion, carrots, and garlic, then stir in the beans, broth, and thyme and simmer for 20 minutes over low heat. Add the kale for the last 5 minutes, cook until wilted, and season to taste before serving.

title: Creamy Corn and Potato Chowder
text: Cook the bacon in a soup pot over medium heat until crisp, then remove it and sauté the onion and celery in the drippings for 4 minutes. Add the potatoes, corn, broth, and dill, bring to a boil, and simmer for 18-20 minutes until the potatoes are soft. Stir in the milk and cream, warm gently for 2 minutes without boiling, and top with the bacon before serving.

title: Moroccan Chickpea and Carrot Stew
text: Set a pot over medium heat and cook the onion and carrots in olive oil for 6 minutes, then add the garlic and spices for 1 minute until fragrant. Stir in the chickpeas, tomatoes, and broth, bring to a simmer, and cook covered for 25 minutes until the carrots are tender. Uncover for the last 5 minutes if you want a thicker stew, then serve warm.

title: Sausage, Cabbage, and Potato Soup
text: Brown the sausage in a large pot over medium heat for 6-7 minutes, then add the onion and garlic and cook until softened. Add the cabbage, potatoes, broth, and oregano, bring to a boil, then reduce to low and simmer for 25 minutes until the potatoes are tender. Taste and adjust seasoning before serving.

title: Lemony Chicken and Rice Soup
text: In a soup pot over medium heat, cook the onion, carrots, and celery in olive oil for 5 minutes. Add the chicken and broth, bring to a simmer, and cook for 15 minutes before removing the chicken, shredding it, and returning it to the pot with the rice. Simmer another 15 minutes until the rice is tender, then stir in lemon juice and parsley just before serving.

title: Three-Bean Chili with Corn
ingredient_lines: 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed
1 can pinto beans, drained and rinsed
1 can black beans, drained and rinsed
text: Cook the onion and bell pepper in olive oil over medium heat for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, chili powder, and cumin for 30 seconds. Stir in the beans, tomatoes, corn, and broth, bring to a boil, then lower the heat and simmer uncovered for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Let it rest for 5 minutes before serving so the flavors settle.

title: Beef, Tomato, and Red Wine Stew
ingredient_lines: 1 1/2 lb beef chuck, cut into cubes
text: Heat the oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches for about 8 minutes total. Add the onion and carrots, cook for 4 minutes, then stir in the garlic and tomato paste for 1 minute before adding the wine, broth, bay leaves, and thyme. Cover and simmer on low for 1 1/2 to 2 hours at a gentle bubble until the beef is tender.

title: Spiced Red Lentil and Tomato Soup
text: Cook the onion in olive oil over medium heat for 4 minutes, then add the garlic, cumin, turmeric, and chili flakes for 30 seconds. Stir in the lentils, tomatoes, and broth, bring to a boil, and simmer uncovered for 20 minutes until the lentils break down. Blend lightly if desired, then season and serve hot.

title: Pork and Apple Stew
text: Brown the pork in olive oil over medium-high heat for 6-8 minutes, then add the onion and cook for 3 minutes more. Stir in the apples, carrots, broth, mustard, and sage, bring to a simmer, cover, and cook on low for 1 hour until the pork is tender. Uncover for the last 10 minutes if you prefer a slightly thicker broth.

title: Mediterranean White Bean and Spinach Soup
ingredient_lines: 2 cans white beans, drained and rinsed
text: Heat the olive oil in a soup pot over medium heat, then cook the onion for 5 minutes before adding the garlic and Italian seasoning for 30 seconds. Add the beans, tomatoes, and broth, bring to a boil, and simmer for 20 minutes so the flavors mingle. Stir in the spinach and lemon juice at the end and cook for 2 minutes until just wilted.

title: Chicken and Mushroom Barley Soup
text: Melt the butter with the oil in a large pot over medium heat, then cook the onion, carrots, and mushrooms for 6 minutes. Add the chicken, broth, barley, and thyme, bring to a boil, and reduce to a simmer for 45 minutes until the barley is tender and the chicken is cooked through. Remove the chicken, shred it, return it to the pot, and season before serving.

title: Lemon Pesto Penne with Cherry Tomatoes
text: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the penne until al dente, about 10-11 minutes. Meanwhile, warm the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat, then cook the garlic for 30 seconds and add the tomatoes until they start to burst, about 4 minutes. Toss in the spinach, drained pasta, pesto, lemon zest, lemon juice, and Parmesan, then cook 1 minute more and season with salt and pepper before serving.

title: Creamy Mushroom Orzo Skillet
text: Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat and cook the onion and mushrooms until browned, about 8-10 minutes. Stir in the garlic and orzo, then pour in the broth and simmer uncovered for 10-12 minutes, stirring often, until the orzo is tender and most of the liquid is absorbed. Add the cream, parsley, salt, and pepper, then cook 2 minutes more until glossy and rich.

title: Spicy Sesame Udon with Bok Choy
text: Cook the udon according to package directions, then drain and set aside. In a hot skillet over medium-high heat, add the sesame oil, bok choy, and bell pepper and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until just tender. Whisk together the soy sauce, rice vinegar, chili garlic sauce, and honey, toss with the noodles and vegetables for 2 minutes, then finish with green onions and sesame seeds.

title: Saffron Tomato Rice with Roasted Chickpeas
text: Heat the oven to 425°F and roast the chickpeas with 1 tablespoon olive oil, paprika, and salt for 20-25 minutes until crisp. In a saucepan, warm the remaining oil and cook the onion until soft, about 5 minutes, then add the garlic, rice, tomatoes, broth, and saffron. Bring to a boil, cover, and simmer on low for 18 minutes; let stand 5 minutes, fluff, and top with the roasted chickpeas.

title: Garlic Lime Rice Noodles with Shrimp
text: Soak or cook the rice noodles according to the package, then drain well. Heat the oil in a large pan over medium-high heat and cook the shrimp for 2-3 minutes per side, then add the garlic, snap peas, and chili and cook 2 minutes more. Toss in the noodles with lime juice, fish sauce, sugar, and cilantro, stirring for 1 minute until everything is hot and coated.

title: One-Pot Tomato Basil Ziti
text: Warm the olive oil in a deep skillet or pot over medium heat and cook the onion for 4 minutes until softened. Add the garlic, ziti, crushed tomatoes, broth, Italian seasoning, and a pinch of salt, then bring to a boil and cook uncovered at a lively simmer for 11-13 minutes, stirring often. Stir in the half-and-half and basil, cook 2 minutes more, and serve as soon as the pasta is tender.

title: Miso Butter Soba with Green Beans
text: Cook the soba and green beans in separate pots of boiling water, draining when the noodles are just tender and the beans are bright green, about 4-5 minutes for the beans and 5-6 minutes for the noodles. Melt the butter in a skillet over low heat, then whisk in the miso, soy sauce, rice vinegar, brown sugar, and sesame oil. Toss in the soba and green beans for 1-2 minutes, then top with sesame seeds and green onions.

title: Turkey and Spinach Rice Pilaf
text: Heat the olive oil in a wide pot over medium heat and cook the turkey with the onion until the meat is no longer pink, about 7-8 minutes. Stir in the garlic, rice, cumin, and smoked paprika, then pour in the broth and bring to a boil. Cover, reduce to low, and cook for 18 minutes; fold in the spinach, cover for 2 more minutes, and fluff before serving.

title: Cheesy Broccoli Pasta Bake
text: Heat the oven to 400°F and cook the pasta and broccoli in boiling salted water until the pasta is almost tender, about 8 minutes, then drain. In a saucepan, melt the butter, whisk in the flour for 1 minute, and slowly add the milk until smooth and thickened, about 3-4 minutes; stir in the cheddar, Parmesan, mustard powder, salt, and pepper. Combine with the pasta and broccoli, transfer to a baking dish, and bake for 20 minutes until bubbling and lightly browned.

title: Teriyaki Beef and Noodle Stir-Fry
text: Cook the egg noodles according to the package directions and drain. Heat the oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat, then sear the beef for 2-3 minutes until browned and remove to a plate. Add the broccoli, carrot, garlic, and ginger, stir-fry for 3 minutes, then return the beef with the noodles and teriyaki sauce; toss for 2 minutes and finish with green onions and sesame seeds.

title: Herbed Lemon Rice with Salmon Flakes
text: Heat the oven to 425°F and roast the salmon on a lined baking sheet with olive oil, salt, pepper, and lemon slices for 12-15 minutes until it flakes easily. While it cooks, simmer the rice with water, shallot, and a pinch of salt covered for 15 minutes, then rest off the heat for 5 minutes. Fluff the rice with lemon juice, dill, and parsley, then fold in chunks of the salmon before serving.

title: Coconut Curry Rice with Peas
text: Warm the coconut oil in a saucepan over medium heat and cook the onion until translucent, about 5 minutes. Stir in the garlic and curry powder for 30 seconds, then add the rice, coconut milk, water, and a little salt; bring to a boil, cover, and simmer on low for 15 minutes. Stir in the peas, cover for 5 minutes more, then finish with lime juice and fluff before serving.

title: Charred Corn and Tomato Herb Salad
text: Heat a grill pan or outdoor grill to medium-high, about 425°F, and cook the corn for 8-10 minutes, turning until lightly charred. Let it cool for 5 minutes, then cut the kernels from the cob and toss with tomatoes, onion, and basil. Whisk the olive oil, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper, then pour over the salad and serve right away or chill for 20 minutes.

title: Cucumber Dill Yogurt Salad
ingredient_lines: 1/2 small red onion, very thinly sliced
text: In a bowl, stir together the yogurt, lemon juice, dill, olive oil, garlic, salt, and pepper until smooth. Add the cucumbers and onion and toss gently to coat. Chill for at least 15 minutes before serving so the flavors can blend.

title: Roasted Beet and Orange Arugula Salad
text: Heat the oven to 400°F and roast the beets on a lined pan for 45-55 minutes, until tender when pierced with a knife. Cool, peel, and slice the beets, then arrange them with arugula, oranges, goat cheese, and pumpkin seeds. Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic vinegar, then season with salt and pepper just before serving.

title: Warm Lentil and Spinach Side Salad
text: Simmer the lentils in water for 20-25 minutes, until tender but not mushy, then drain well. Whisk the olive oil, mustard, lemon juice, salt, and pepper in a large bowl. Add the warm lentils, spinach, cucumber, and parsley, tossing until the spinach just begins to wilt, and serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Shaved Brussels Sprouts Salad with Parmesan
text: Slice the Brussels sprouts very thinly with a knife or shredding blade, then place them in a bowl with the apple, Parmesan, and almonds. Whisk together the olive oil, vinegar, maple syrup, salt, and pepper. Toss everything well and let the salad sit for 10 minutes before serving so the sprouts soften slightly.

title: Garlic Parmesan Roasted Green Beans
text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the green beans with olive oil, garlic, salt, black pepper, and a pinch of red pepper flakes, then spread them on a baking sheet in a single layer. Roast for 14-18 minutes, sprinkle with Parmesan and lemon zest, and serve immediately.

title: Sesame Ginger Carrot Ribbon Salad
text: Whisk the rice vinegar, sesame oil, soy sauce, honey, and ginger in a bowl. Add the carrot ribbons and bell pepper, then toss until evenly coated. Finish with sesame seeds and green onions, and let it rest for 5-10 minutes before serving.

title: Creamy Broccoli Grape Salad
text: Blanch the broccoli in boiling water for 1 minute, then drain and rinse under cold water; pat dry. Stir together the mayonnaise, yogurt, vinegar, sugar, and salt in a large bowl, then fold in the broccoli, grapes, celery, and sunflower seeds. Chill for 30 minutes before serving.

title: Herbed Roasted Zucchini and Onions
ingredient_lines: 1 teaspoon chopped thyme or 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme
text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the zucchini and onion with olive oil, oregano, thyme, garlic, salt, and pepper, then spread on a baking sheet. Roast for 20-25 minutes, stirring once halfway through, and finish with parsley before serving.

title: Tomato Peach Basil Salad
text: Combine the peaches, tomatoes, onion, and basil in a wide serving bowl. Whisk the olive oil, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper together, then drizzle over the salad. Toss very gently and let sit for 10 minutes so the juices mingle.

title: Roasted Cauliflower with Tahini Drizzle
ingredient_lines: 1 large head cauliflower, cut into florets
text: Heat the oven to 425°F and toss the cauliflower with olive oil, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper. Roast on a baking sheet for 25-30 minutes, stirring once, until browned at the edges. Mix the tahini, lemon juice, and warm water into a pourable sauce, then drizzle over the cauliflower before serving.

title: Radish and Herb Butter Lettuce Salad
text: Place the lettuce, radishes, cucumber, and herbs in a salad bowl. Whisk the olive oil, lemon juice, Dijon mustard, salt, and pepper in a small bowl until emulsified. Toss lightly with the greens and serve immediately for the freshest crunch.

title: Spinach and Feta Breakfast Strata
text: Preheat the oven to 350°F and grease a 9x13-inch baking dish. Sauté the onion in butter for 5 minutes, then stir in the spinach just until wilted. Whisk the eggs, milk, salt, and pepper, then layer the bread, vegetables, and cheeses in the dish and pour the egg mixture over top. Bake for 35-40 minutes, until puffed and set in the center.

title: Cinnamon Swirl Apple Pancakes
text: Mix the flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in one bowl, then whisk the milk, eggs, and melted butter in another. Fold the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients, then stir in the apples. In a small bowl, combine cinnamon and brown sugar; spoon batter onto a buttered skillet over medium heat, sprinkle a little cinnamon sugar on each pancake, and cook for 2-3 minutes per side.

title: Savory Cheddar Herb Scones
text: Heat the oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Cut the butter into the flour, baking powder, salt, and pepper until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs, then stir in the cheese and herbs. Add the buttermilk just until a dough forms, shape into a 1-inch thick round, cut into wedges, and bake for 16-18 minutes until golden.

title: Smoked Sausage Breakfast Skillet
text: Warm the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the potatoes for 10-12 minutes, stirring often, until browned and tender. Add the sausage, onion, bell pepper, paprika, salt, and pepper, and cook for another 5 minutes. Make 4 small wells in the skillet, crack in the eggs, cover, and cook for 4-6 minutes until the whites are set.

title: Blueberry Ricotta Toast Bake
text: Preheat the oven to 375°F and butter an 8x8-inch baking dish. Whisk the ricotta, eggs, maple syrup, and vanilla together, then spread the brioche slices in the dish and pour the mixture over them. Scatter the blueberries, lemon zest, and almonds on top, then bake for 25-30 minutes until the center is set and the top is lightly browned. Dust with powdered sugar before serving.

title: Tomato Basil Shakshuka with Potatoes
text: Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and cook the onion and bell pepper for 6-7 minutes. Stir in the potatoes, garlic, tomatoes, cumin, chili flakes, salt, and pepper, then simmer for 10 minutes until slightly thickened. Make 6 little wells, crack in the eggs, cover, and cook for 6-8 minutes until the whites are just set; finish with basil.

title: Maple Pecan Baked Oatmeal
text: Preheat the oven to 350°F and grease a 9-inch square baking dish. Stir together the oats, baking powder, cinnamon, salt, pecans, and pears in the dish, then whisk the eggs, milk, maple syrup, and butter and pour over the top. Bake for 35-40 minutes until the center is set and the edges are golden. Let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing.

title: Ham and Swiss Croissant Casserole
text: Set the oven to 375°F and butter a baking dish. Layer the croissant pieces, ham, and Swiss cheese in the dish, then whisk the eggs, half-and-half, mustard, salt, pepper, and thyme. Pour the custard over everything, pressing the bread down slightly, and let it soak for 10 minutes before baking for 30-35 minutes until puffed and browned.

title: Lemon Poppy Seed Yogurt Muffins
text: Preheat the oven to 400°F and line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners. Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, salt, and poppy seeds in one bowl, then mix the yogurt, eggs, oil, lemon juice, and zest in another. Combine the wet and dry ingredients just until blended, divide among the cups, and bake for 16-19 minutes until the tops spring back.

title: Mushroom Goat Cheese Omelet Bake
text: Preheat the oven to 375°F. Cook the mushrooms and shallot in butter over medium heat for 6-7 minutes until browned, then add the spinach and stir just until wilted. Whisk the eggs, milk, salt, and pepper, pour into a greased baking dish, scatter the mushroom mixture and goat cheese on top, and bake for 18-22 minutes until the center is firm.

title: Strawberry Almond Breakfast Parfaits
text: Stir the yogurt with honey, vanilla, and a tiny pinch of salt until smooth. Layer the yogurt, strawberries, granola, almonds, and chia seeds into glasses or bowls, repeating until everything is used. Chill for 10 minutes if you want a colder parfait, then garnish with mint and serve right away.

title: Chorizo Sweet Potato Breakfast Tacos
ingredient_lines: 2 medium sweet potatoes, peeled and diced
text: Cook the sweet potatoes in olive oil over medium heat for 12-15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until tender and browned. Add the chorizo and cumin and cook for 5 minutes, then scramble in the eggs until just set. Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet for 30 seconds per side, fill with the mixture, and top with avocado, cilantro, and lime.

title: Cinnamon Sugar Pull-Apart Bread
text: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, and salt, then stir in the warm milk, melted butter, and eggs until a soft dough forms. Knead for 8 minutes, let rise covered for 1 hour, then roll out, sprinkle with brown sugar and cinnamon, stack into strips, and place in a loaf pan. Let rise 30 minutes more, then bake at 350°F for 30-35 minutes until deep golden.

title: Blueberry Lemon Scones
text: Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt, then cut in the butter until the mixture looks crumbly. Fold in the blueberries and lemon zest, then add the cream and egg just until the dough comes together. Shape into a disk, cut into wedges, and bake at 400°F for 18-22 minutes until lightly browned.

title: Chocolate Chip Banana Muffins
text: Stir together the mashed bananas, melted butter, eggs, and sugars, then mix in the flour, baking soda, and salt until combined. Fold in the chocolate chips and divide the batter into a lined muffin tin. Bake at 375°F for 18-20 minutes, then cool for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Rustic Rosemary Focaccia
text: Combine the flour, yeast, salt, warm water, and half the olive oil into a sticky dough, then cover and let rise for 1 hour. Spread the dough into an oiled pan, dimple the surface, and drizzle with the remaining oil, rosemary, coarse salt, and pepper. Bake at 425°F for 22-25 minutes until crisp and deeply golden.

title: Strawberry Hand Pies
text: Cook the strawberries, sugar, cornstarch, and vanilla in a small pan over medium heat for 5 minutes until thickened, then cool slightly. Cut the pastry into squares, fill each with the fruit mixture, fold over, and crimp the edges. Brush with egg wash and milk, then bake at 400°F for 16-18 minutes until puffed and browned.

title: Almond Butter Oat Cookies
text: Mix the oats, flour, baking soda, and salt in one bowl, then whisk the almond butter, brown sugar, egg, and vanilla in another. Stir everything together and fold in the chopped almonds. Scoop onto a baking sheet and bake at 350°F for 10-12 minutes until set at the edges.

title: Pumpkin Spice Coffee Cake
text: Whisk the pumpkin puree, sugar, oil, and eggs until smooth, then stir in the flour, spice, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Pour the batter into a greased pan and top with a simple streusel if you like. Bake at 350°F for 35-40 minutes, or until a toothpick comes out clean.

title: Cherry Almond Tea Loaf
text: Mix the flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar, then add the eggs, milk, melted butter, and almond extract and stir until just combined. Fold in the dried cherries and spoon the batter into a loaf pan. Bake at 350°F for 45-50 minutes, then cool before slicing.

title: Vanilla Bean Custard Tart
text: Warm the milk in a saucepan, then whisk the yolks, sugar, and cornstarch in a bowl. Slowly pour in the hot milk, return the mixture to the pan, and cook over medium heat for 4-6 minutes until thick, then stir in the vanilla and butter. Pour into the tart shell, chill for 2 hours, and top with berries before serving.

title: Peanut Butter Brownie Bars
text: Melt the butter, then whisk in the sugar, eggs, cocoa, flour, and salt until glossy. Spread half the batter in a lined pan, dollop with peanut butter, add the rest of the batter, and scatter chocolate chunks on top. Bake at 350°F for 28-32 minutes, then cool completely before cutting into bars.

title: Orange Olive Oil Cake
text: Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt together, then add the eggs, olive oil, orange juice, and zest and mix until smooth. Pour into a greased cake pan and tap gently to remove air bubbles. Bake at 350°F for 30-35 minutes, then cool and dust with powdered sugar if desired.

title: Coconut Pineapple Cake Squares
text: Stir the flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt together, then mix in the coconut milk, melted butter, and eggs until just smooth. Fold in the pineapple and shredded coconut, then spread the batter into a greased square pan. Bake at 350°F for 32-38 minutes until the center is set and the top is lightly browned.

title: Chicken Tinga Tostada Skillet
text: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium-high heat, then brown the chicken for 3-4 minutes per side. Add the onion, garlic, chipotles, tomatoes, cumin, and salt, cover, and simmer on low for 20 minutes or until the chicken is tender and shreds easily. Shred the chicken, spoon it over the tostadas, and top with lettuce and any extras you like.

title: Beef Picadillo with Potatoes and Raisins
text: Warm the oil in a large skillet over medium heat, then cook the onion, garlic, and beef until the meat is browned, about 6-8 minutes. Stir in the potatoes, tomatoes, raisins, cumin, cinnamon, salt, and pepper, then add a splash of water, cover, and cook on low for 20-25 minutes until the potatoes are tender. Uncover for the last 5 minutes to thicken the sauce before serving with rice or tortillas.

title: Pozole Verde with Pork
text: Heat the oil in a pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork on all sides, about 5 minutes. Add the onion, garlic, broth, tomatillos, poblanos, hominy, oregano, and salt, then simmer covered at 325°F for 1 1/2 to 2 hours, or until the pork is very tender. Serve hot with shredded cabbage, radishes, and lime.

title: Black Bean and Cheese Enchiladas
text: Preheat the oven to 375°F and lightly oil a baking dish. Mix the black beans with the onion, cumin, and a pinch of salt, then spoon into tortillas with a little cheese, roll them up, and place seam-side down in the dish. Pour the enchilada sauce over the top, scatter on the remaining cheese, and bake for 20-25 minutes until bubbling; finish with cilantro.

title: Arroz con Pollo One-Pot Dinner
text: Season the chicken with salt and pepper, then brown it in a large pot over medium-high heat for 4 minutes per side. Add the onion, bell pepper, garlic, rice, tomatoes, broth, and paprika, then bring to a boil, cover, and cook on low for 25 minutes. Stir in the peas, rest for 5 minutes off the heat, and fluff before serving.

title: Peruvian-Style Roasted Chicken with Aji Verde
text: Preheat the oven to 400°F and rub the chicken with oil, garlic, lime juice, cumin, salt, and pepper. Roast on a sheet pan for 40-45 minutes, turning once, until the skin is browned and the chicken reaches 165°F. Blend the cilantro, jalapeño, mayonnaise, avocado, and a squeeze of lime into a bright sauce, then serve it alongside the chicken.

title: Sweet Potato and Poblano Tamale Pie
text: Preheat the oven to 375°F and grease a baking dish. Roast or sauté the sweet potatoes with the poblano, onion, chili powder, cumin, and salt until just tender, about 10-12 minutes, then stir in the corn and black beans. Spread the mixture in the dish, pour the cornbread batter over the top, sprinkle with cheese, and bake for 25-30 minutes until golden.

title: Cuban Mojo Pork Rice Bowls
text: Marinate the pork with garlic, orange juice, lime juice, oregano, salt, and pepper for at least 15 minutes. Sear it in oil over medium-high heat for 2-3 minutes per side, then finish in a 400°F oven for 12-15 minutes until it reaches 145°F and rests juicy. Slice the pork and serve over rice with avocado and cucumber.

title: Shrimp Ceviche Lettuce Cups
text: Chop the cooked shrimp into bite-size pieces and toss with lime juice, tomato, red onion, jalapeño, cilantro, and salt. Let it sit in the refrigerator for 15-20 minutes so the flavors meld, then fold in the avocado right before serving. Spoon into lettuce leaves and serve chilled with tortilla chips.

title: Plantain and Black Bean Empanadas
text: Cook the plantains in a skillet over medium heat until softened and lightly caramelized, about 8 minutes, then mash them with the black beans, onion, cumin, paprika, and cheese. Fill each dough disc with the mixture, fold and seal the edges, and brush the tops with beaten egg and a little oil. Bake at 400°F for 18-22 minutes until golden and crisp.

title: Tortilla Soup with Avocado and Crispy Strips
text: Cut 4 tortillas into strips and fry or bake them at 400°F for 8-10 minutes until crisp, then set aside. In a pot, cook the onion and garlic in oil for 3-4 minutes, add the tomatoes, broth, chili powder, and black beans, and simmer for 15 minutes. Ladle into bowls and top with avocado, crispy tortilla strips, and lime.

title: Corn and Chicken Flautas with Green Sauce
text: Preheat the oven to 425°F and mix the chicken, corn, cream cheese, and chili powder in a bowl. Spoon the filling into tortillas, roll tightly, and place seam-side down on a baking sheet; brush lightly with oil and bake for 15-18 minutes until crisp. Serve with warm salsa verde, sour cream, lettuce, and cotija.

title: Butter Chicken with Tomato Cashew Sauce
ingredient_lines: 1 1/2 lb boneless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces
1/2 cup cashews, soaked and blended with water
text: Mix the chicken with yogurt, lemon juice, garam masala, cumin, and a pinch of salt, then marinate for at least 20 minutes. Cook the chicken in 1 tbsp butter over medium-high heat for 6 to 8 minutes until browned, then remove it. In the same pan, sauté the onion, garlic, and ginger for 5 minutes, add tomato puree and the cashew paste, and simmer 10 minutes at a gentle bubble. Stir in the cream, return the chicken, and cook 5 more minutes until hot; serve with basmati rice.

title: Chana Masala with Spinach
text: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat and cook the onion for 6 to 7 minutes until soft. Add the garlic, ginger, coriander, cumin, turmeric, and chili powder, and stir for 1 minute, then add the chickpeas, tomatoes, and water. Simmer uncovered for 15 minutes over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally, until thickened. Fold in the spinach and garam masala for 2 minutes until wilted, then finish with salt and lemon juice.

title: South Indian Coconut Lentil Dal
text: Combine the lentils, water, and turmeric in a pot and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 to 18 minutes until soft. In a small pan, heat the oil over medium heat and crackle the mustard seeds, cumin seeds, and curry leaves for 30 seconds, then add the onion, garlic, and ginger and cook 5 minutes. Stir the tempering and coconut milk into the dal, simmer 3 minutes more, and season with salt. Serve hot over rice with cilantro.

title: Aloo Gobi with Tomato and Peas
text: Warm the oil in a large skillet over medium heat and cook the onion for 4 minutes until translucent. Add the potatoes, cauliflower, peas, tomatoes, coriander, cumin, turmeric, chili flakes, and salt, then toss well. Cover and cook over medium-low heat for 20 to 25 minutes, stirring once or twice, until the potatoes are tender and the cauliflower is cooked through. Uncover for the last 3 minutes to reduce any moisture, then top with cilantro.

title: Tandoori Sheet-Pan Chicken and Vegetables
text: Mix the yogurt, tandoori spice blend, lemon juice, oil, and salt, then coat the chicken and let it marinate for 30 minutes or up to overnight. Heat the oven to 425°F and arrange the chicken, onion, peppers, and zucchini on a lined sheet pan. Roast for 35 to 40 minutes, turning the vegetables once, until the chicken is cooked through and lightly charred at the edges. Serve with lime wedges and naan or rice.

title: Vegetable Biryani with Saffron Rice
text: Soak the rice in water for 20 minutes, then cook it with the saffron until just tender and drain if needed. In a wide pot, heat the ghee over medium heat and fry the onion for 8 minutes until golden, then add the carrot, cauliflower, beans, peas, biryani masala, yogurt, and salt. Cook covered over low heat for 12 minutes, then layer in the rice with mint and cilantro and steam on low for 10 minutes. Fluff gently before serving.

title: Keema Peas Skillet
text: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and brown the meat for 5 to 6 minutes, breaking it up as it cooks. Add the onion, garlic, ginger, garam masala, cumin, and turmeric, and cook for 4 minutes until fragrant. Stir in the crushed tomatoes and peas, lower the heat to medium, and simmer for 10 minutes until the mixture thickens. Season with salt and garnish with cilantro before serving with naan.

title: Paneer Tikka Skewers
ingredient_lines: 1 red bell pepper, cut into chunks
text: Whisk the yogurt, tandoori spice blend, lemon juice, oil, and salt, then coat the paneer, pepper, and onion and marinate for 20 to 30 minutes. Thread the pieces onto skewers and place them on a greased baking sheet. Broil on high for 8 to 10 minutes, turning once, until browned in spots and heated through. Serve immediately with mint chutney.

title: Methi Chicken Curry
ingredient_lines: 1 1/2 lb chicken thighs, boneless and skinless
1 cup chopped fenugreek leaves (fresh or frozen)
text: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat and cook the onion for 6 minutes until softened. Add the garlic, ginger, coriander, cumin, and paprika, then stir for 1 minute before adding the chicken and browning it lightly. Pour in the tomato puree, fenugreek leaves, water, and salt, then simmer covered over low heat for 25 minutes until the chicken is tender. Uncover for 5 minutes to thicken, then serve with rice.

title: Masala Egg Curry
text: Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 5 to 6 minutes until golden. Add the garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, and turmeric, and cook for 1 minute, then stir in the tomato sauce, water, and salt. Simmer for 10 minutes over medium-low heat, gently add the eggs, and cook 5 minutes more so they absorb the sauce. Finish with cream and cilantro before serving.

title: Coconut Tamarind Fish Curry
ingredient_lines: 1 1/2 lb firm white fish, cut into large pieces
text: Warm the oil in a skillet over medium heat and cook the onion for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger, turmeric, and coriander and stir for 1 minute. Pour in the coconut milk, water, tamarind paste, and salt, then bring to a gentle simmer. Nestle in the fish, cover, and cook over low heat for 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily. Garnish with cilantro and serve with rice.

title: Spiced Chickpea and Potato Samosa Filling Bowls
ingredient_lines: plain yogurt or chutney, for serving
text: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat and cook the onion for 4 minutes. Add the potatoes, chickpeas, cumin, coriander, turmeric, chili powder, and salt, then stir well and cover with a splash of water. Cook over medium-low heat for 18 to 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the potatoes are tender; add the peas for the last 3 minutes. Finish with lemon juice and cilantro, then serve warm with yogurt or chutney.

title: Miso-Glazed Eggplant with Sesame Rice
ingredient_lines: 2 medium eggplants, cut into thick wedges
text: Heat the oven to 425°F and toss the eggplant with oil on a lined baking sheet. Roast for 20 minutes, then brush with a mix of miso, soy sauce, honey, and rice vinegar and return to the oven for 8 to 10 minutes until glossy and tender. Serve over warm jasmine rice and finish with sesame seeds.

title: Vietnamese Lemongrass Chicken Skillet
text: Warm the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat, then cook the chicken with onion, lemongrass, and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes. Stir in fish sauce, brown sugar, and broth, then simmer for 5 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce clings lightly. Scatter cilantro over the top and serve with steamed rice.

title: Thai Basil Pork Lettuce Cups
text: Brown the pork in a hot skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up as it cooks for about 5 minutes. Add garlic, chili, green beans, soy sauce, oyster sauce, and sugar, then cook 4 to 5 minutes more until the beans are crisp-tender. Stir in the basil just before serving and spoon the mixture into lettuce leaves.

title: Korean Beef and Cabbage Rice Bowl
text: Cook the beef in a skillet over medium heat for 5 to 6 minutes, then add garlic, cabbage, soy sauce, gochujang, and brown sugar. Continue cooking for 4 minutes until the cabbage softens and the sauce turns sticky, then stir in sesame oil. Spoon over rice and top with scallions.

title: Teriyaki Salmon with Broccoli and Rice
text: Heat the oven to 400°F and place the salmon and broccoli on a sheet pan. Mix soy sauce, mirin, honey, ginger, and oil, then brush over the salmon and drizzle the broccoli. Roast for 12 to 15 minutes until the salmon flakes easily and the broccoli is lightly browned, then serve with rice.

title: Singapore-Style Curry Noodles with Shrimp
text: Soak or cook the noodles according to the package directions, then set them aside. In a large pot, cook onion and bell pepper in oil for 4 minutes, stir in curry powder, coconut milk, and broth, and simmer for 5 minutes. Add shrimp and noodles, then cook 3 to 4 minutes until the shrimp are pink; finish with scallions.

title: Japanese Chicken Katsu with Cabbage Salad
text: Season the chicken with salt and pepper, then coat each piece in flour, egg, and panko. Fry in a skillet over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side until deeply golden and cooked through, then drain briefly on paper towels. Toss the cabbage with tonkatsu sauce and serve alongside the sliced cutlets.

title: Coconut Pumpkin Curry with Green Beans
ingredient_lines: 2 cups pumpkin or kabocha squash, cubed
text: Cook the onion and garlic in oil over medium heat for 3 minutes, then stir in the curry paste for 30 seconds. Add pumpkin, coconut milk, and enough water to barely cover, then simmer for 15 minutes until the squash is almost tender. Add green beans, fish sauce, and sugar, and cook 5 minutes more before serving with rice.

title: Indonesian Tempeh Peanut Noodles
text: Cook the noodles, drain them, and keep them warm. Pan-fry the tempeh in oil over medium heat for 4 to 5 minutes per side until browned, then whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice, chili sauce, and water into a smooth sauce. Toss the noodles with the sauce and tempeh, and serve with cucumber slices on the side.

title: Filipino Garlic Fried Rice with Shrimp
text: Heat the oil in a wide skillet over medium heat and cook the garlic until fragrant and lightly golden, about 1 minute. Add the shrimp and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, then stir in the rice, soy sauce, and pepper and fry for 5 minutes until heated through. Push the rice aside, scramble the eggs in the pan, and finish with scallions.

title: Cambodian Ginger Pork Meatballs
text: Mix the pork, egg, breadcrumbs, ginger, garlic, soy sauce, and fish sauce, then form into small meatballs. Pan-fry in oil over medium heat for 10 to 12 minutes, turning often, until browned and cooked through. Serve the meatballs with cucumber ribbons and spoon over any pan juices.

title: Stir-Fried Tofu with Long Beans and Chili Garlic Sauce
ingredient_lines: 1 block firm tofu, pressed and cubed
2 cups long beans or green beans, cut into pieces
text: Brown the tofu in oil over medium-high heat for 8 minutes, turning until crisp on most sides. Add garlic and beans and stir-fry for 4 minutes, then mix in chili garlic sauce, soy sauce, sugar, and water. Cook 2 to 3 minutes until the sauce lightly coats everything, and sprinkle with sesame seeds before serving.

title: Za'atar Chicken with Roasted Potatoes and Onions
text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the potatoes and onion with half the oil, half the za'atar, salt, and pepper, then spread on a sheet pan and roast for 20 minutes. Rub the chicken with the remaining oil and za'atar, place it on the pan, and roast 25 to 30 minutes more until the chicken reaches 165°F and the potatoes are tender; serve with lemon wedges.

title: Harissa Chickpea and Tomato Skillet
text: Warm the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat, then cook the onion until softened, about 5 minutes. Stir in the garlic and harissa for 30 seconds, then add the chickpeas, tomatoes, water, cumin, and salt; simmer uncovered for 15 to 18 minutes until thickened. Serve hot with bread, rice, or couscous.

title: Lemon Herb Fish with Tomatoes and Olives
text: Heat the oven to 400°F. In a baking dish, toss the tomatoes, olives, garlic, olive oil, lemon zest, oregano, salt, and pepper, then nestle the fish into the mixture and drizzle with lemon juice. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until the fish flakes easily and the tomatoes have burst.

title: Middle Eastern Beef and Rice Pilaf
text: Toast the almonds in a dry saucepan over medium heat until golden, then set aside. In the same pan, cook the onion in olive oil until soft, add the beef and brown it well, then stir in the rice, cinnamon, allspice, salt, and broth. Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook on low for 18 minutes; rest 5 minutes before fluffing and topping with the almonds.

title: Spinach and Feta Phyllo Pie
text: Heat the oven to 375°F and lightly oil a baking dish. Cook the onion until soft, stir in the spinach just until wilted, then mix with feta, ricotta, eggs, nutmeg, and salt; layer half the phyllo sheets in the dish, brushing each with oil, add the filling, then top with the remaining phyllo. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes until crisp and deeply golden.

title: Moroccan Carrot and Orange Salad
text: Whisk the olive oil, lemon juice, honey, cumin, and a pinch of salt in a large bowl. Add the carrots, orange segments, and mint, then toss until everything is evenly coated. Chill for 15 minutes before serving so the flavors blend.

title: Sheet-Pan Shawarma Cauliflower and Chickpeas
ingredient_lines: 1 large head cauliflower, cut into florets
text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the cauliflower, chickpeas, and onion with olive oil, shawarma spice, and salt, then spread on a sheet pan and roast for 25 to 30 minutes, stirring once halfway through. Finish with lemon juice and parsley, then serve right away.

title: Turkish-Style Stuffed Bell Peppers
text: Heat the oven to 375°F and cut the tops off the peppers, removing the seeds. Cook the onion and lamb in a skillet until browned, stir in the garlic, paprika, cumin, rice, half the tomato sauce, and salt, then fill the peppers with the mixture and place them in a baking dish. Spoon the remaining sauce over the tops, cover with foil, and bake for 35 minutes; uncover and bake 10 minutes more.

title: Creamy Tahini Roasted Eggplant Pasta
text: Heat the oven to 425°F and roast the eggplant with olive oil and salt for 25 minutes until browned and soft. Cook the pasta, then whisk the tahini, lemon juice, garlic, and enough pasta water to make a creamy sauce. Toss the pasta with the eggplant and sauce, then finish with parsley.

title: Saffron Shrimp and Couscous Bowls
text: Steep the saffron in the hot water for 5 minutes, then pour it over the couscous, cover, and let stand 10 minutes. Meanwhile, sauté the zucchini in olive oil for 4 to 5 minutes, add the tomatoes, shrimp, paprika, and salt, and cook until the shrimp turn pink, about 3 to 4 minutes. Fluff the couscous and spoon the shrimp mixture over the top.

title: Labneh Chicken Wraps with Cucumber and Herbs
text: Season the chicken with salt and cook it in olive oil over medium-high heat for 6 to 8 minutes until browned and cooked through. Stir the labneh with sumac and a splash of water to loosen it, then spread it over the flatbreads and top with chicken, cucumber, tomatoes, dill, and parsley. Fold and serve immediately, or wrap tightly for lunch later.

title: Baked Feta and Herb Tomato Orzo
text: Heat the oven to 400°F. In a baking dish, combine the orzo, tomatoes, garlic, oregano, broth, olive oil, and a little salt, then place the feta block in the center and bake for 25 minutes. Stir well to melt the feta into the orzo, then finish with basil and serve hot.

title: Turkey Pesto Mozzarella Melts
text: Spread mayonnaise on one side of each bread slice and pesto on the other, then layer turkey, tomato, and mozzarella between 4 sandwiches. Heat a skillet over medium heat, butter the outside of the bread, and cook the sandwiches for 3 to 4 minutes per side until deep golden and the cheese is melted. Let them rest for 1 minute before slicing.

title: Spicy Chickpea Smash Wraps
text: Mash the chickpeas with yogurt, lemon juice, olive oil, paprika, chili flakes, and salt until chunky but spreadable. Warm the tortillas for 20 seconds in a dry skillet, then fill with the chickpea mixture, lettuce, and cucumber. Roll tightly and serve right away, or chill for 15 minutes for easier slicing.

title: Ham, Apple, and Cheddar Panini
text: Stir the honey into the mustard, then spread it over the bread and build each sandwich with ham, cheddar, and apple slices. Butter the outsides and grill in a panini press or skillet over medium heat for 4 to 5 minutes, flipping once if needed, until crisp and the cheese is fully melted. Cool for 2 minutes before cutting.

title: Creamy Avocado Tuna Tea Sandwiches
text: Mash the avocado with mayonnaise, lime juice, dill, salt, and pepper, then fold in the tuna and celery. Spread the mixture on 4 bread slices, top with the remaining slices, and trim the crusts if you like. Chill for 10 minutes before cutting into fingers or triangles.

title: Crispy Potato and Scallion Cakes
text: Mix the mashed potatoes, scallions, egg, flour, garlic powder, and salt into a thick dough. Form into 8 small cakes and pan-fry in butter and oil over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side until crisp and browned. Serve hot with sour cream or ketchup.

title: Sesame Honey Pretzel Bites
text: Heat the oven to 425°F and line a baking sheet with parchment. Roll the dough into small ropes, cut into bite-size pieces, dip in egg wash, and sprinkle with sesame seeds and salt. Bake for 12 to 14 minutes until puffed and golden, then brush with honey-butter while warm.

title: Roasted Red Pepper Yogurt Dip
text: Blend the roasted peppers, yogurt, garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, cumin, salt, and pepper until smooth. Taste and adjust the seasoning, then chill for at least 20 minutes so the flavors settle. Serve cold with vegetables, pita, or crackers.

title: Garlic Herb Mayo
text: Whisk the mayonnaise with garlic, parsley, chives, lemon zest, lemon juice, salt, and pepper until evenly combined. Cover and refrigerate for 15 minutes before using to let the flavors blend. Keep chilled and spread on sandwiches or use as a dip.

title: Tomato Basil Bruschetta Toasts
text: Heat the oven to 400°F and toast the baguette slices for 6 to 8 minutes until crisp. Stir the tomatoes with olive oil, balsamic vinegar, basil, garlic, salt, and pepper, then spoon onto the warm toasts. Serve immediately so the bread stays crunchy.

title: Cranberry Chicken Salad Sliders
text: Mix the chicken with mayonnaise, yogurt, cranberries, celery, green onion, salt, and pepper. Split the buns, layer with lettuce and chicken salad, then close and lightly press. Serve at once, or chill for 20 minutes for a firmer filling.

title: Warm Spinach Artichoke Pita Pockets
text: Stir together the cream cheese, sour cream, mozzarella, garlic, spinach, artichokes, salt, and pepper. Warm the mixture in a skillet over low heat for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring until hot, then spoon into split pita breads. Toast the filled pitas in a 375°F oven for 5 minutes if you want extra crunch.

title: Cilantro Lime Salsa Verde
text: Place the tomatillos, jalapeño, onion, and garlic on a baking sheet and roast at 425°F for 15 minutes until softened and lightly charred. Blend with cilantro, lime juice, salt, and water until smooth, adding more water for a thinner sauce. Cool before serving, or refrigerate for up to 5 days.
